youtube.aciklama: At sea level, atmospheric pressure is about 100,000 pascals. The faintest sound we can hear near 1000 Hz is about 20 micropascals, and normal speech at one meter is about 0.02 pascals, less than one millionth of atmospheric pressure. About 20 pascals is one million times the threshold.
